import sys

class MetroSim:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def move(self):
        jump = self.t % self.n
        self.t -= 1
        if self.s < self.m:
            self.s = (self.s + jump) % self.n
        else:
            self.s -= jump
            self.s %= self.n
            if self.s < 0:
                self.s += self.n

    def batch(self):
        for _ in range(self.n):
            self.move()

    def run(self, n, m, s, t):
        self.n = n
        self.m = m
        self.s = s
        self.t = t

        while self.t % self.n != 0:
            self.move()

        seen = {}
        while self.t != 0:
            self.batch()
            if self.s in seen:
                previous = seen[self.s]
                interval = previous - self.t
                self.t %= interval
                break
            else:
                seen[self.s] = self.t

        while self.t != 0:
            self.move()

        print(self.s + 1)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().replace(',', ' ').split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    s = int(next(it)) - 1
    t = int(next(it))
    sim = MetroSim()
    sim.run(n, m, s, t)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
